regions.name: British Columbia
regions.description: All of BC, plus about 50 km into Alberta, Yukon, Alaska, Washington, Idaho and Montana so routes can cross the border. Includes 1.3 million BC addresses, 140,000 businesses (from Overture Maps), rec sites and rest areas.

regions.name: Alberta
regions.description: All of Alberta, plus about 50 km into BC, Saskatchewan, the NWT and Montana so routes can cross the border. Includes 1.2 million addresses and 108,000 extra businesses (from Overture Maps).

regions.name: Washington
regions.description: All of Washington, plus about 50 km into BC, Oregon and Idaho (Vancouver, Portland) so routes can cross the border. Includes 3 million addresses and 376,000 extra businesses (from Overture Maps).
